killedBy: the retarget REASON is recorded, not just returned (issue #359) records ACQUIRED on the first commitment, and ages from there
the retarget REASON is recorded, not just returned (issue #359) records TARGET-LOST when the committed opponent dies, and resets the age
why: Restores the state before issue #359: `commitTarget` computes a reason, returns it, and nothing records it -- which is exactly what shipped, since `ai/index.ts` calls it as a bare statement and discards the return. The commitment itself stayed observable through `aiTargetId`/`aiTargetTicks` the whole time, so a thrashing AI could be watched switching and never asked why. This mutation is the shipped bug, not an invented one.
